fact: The Central Ethiopia Regional Health Bureau's page states that Ethiopia's EMR system is led by the Federal Ministry of Health with regional health bureaus and development partners, that EMR systems (SmartCare, OpenMRS and regionally customised ones) are implemented in health centres and hospitals to replace paper records, and that they provide for real-time entry at the point of care; the page carries no date of its own and was archived on 11 July 2026.
title: Digital Health Systems
